title: Development · One player plays both
description: Development solo mode (just dev-solo): one player drives Gerard and Aitor. The status screen stays one wide sheet with both members, and the fight keeps a single dock that follows whoever's turn it is, with a badge saying it is the debug mode.

steps.caption: Solo debug: one wide sheet, the badge, and both members' ánimas (Gerard without, Aitor with Noísta)
One dock follows the turn: Gerard's vitals, his ánima switch and commands; Aitor waits on the right
Aitor's turn on the same keyboard: his card moves into the dock, in Noísta's colours
Aitor's skills with Noísta: No-ta from the ánima and Abrazo, his own
